home.fr: Restez solides, nous les avons gênés à dix. Tenez bon avec courage.

away.en: Game still there. Possession is ours, calm heads, push for one last chance.
away.es: El partido está ahí. La posesión es nuestra, cabeza fría, busquemos la última oportunidad.
away.pt: Jogo continua, a posse é nossa, cabeça fria, vamos à última oportunidade.
away.fr: Le match est ouvert. Nous dominons le ballon, gardons la tête froide, cherchons une dernière occasion.

headline.pt: Gol no fim vira o jogo

story.en: Adam Penke struck in the 82nd, Eastholme Rangers' win chance jumps from 12% to 83%. Eastholme lead 2-1 and already have a player sent off, putting them firmly ahead.
story.es: Adam Penke marcó al 82, la probabilidad de victoria de Eastholme Rangers sube de 12% a 83%. Eastholme gana 2-1 y ya tiene un jugador expulsado, lo que les deja en ventaja.
story.pt: Adam Penke marcou aos 82, a chance de vitória do Eastholme Rangers sobe de 12% para 83%. O Eastholme lidera 2-1 e já teve um jogador expulso, deixando-os na frente.
story.fr: Adam Penke a marqué à la 82e, la chance de victoire d'Eastholme Rangers passe de 12% à 83%. Eastholme mène 2-1 et a déjà un joueur expulsé, ils prennent l'avantage net.

analyst.en: Eastholme now 83% to win, up from 12%, driven almost entirely by the Adam Penke 82' goal. Possession favors Brackenford 63% to 37%, but the goal and red card swung the points.

home.en: That Penke strike paid off, hold tight, finish this for the fans.
home.es: Ese gol de Penke funcionó, aguanten, rematen esto por la afición.
home.pt: Esse gol de Penke deu certo, resistam, encerrem para os torcedores.
home.fr: Ce but de Penke a payé, tenez bon, concluez pour les supporters.

away.en: Keep pushing despite the score, you control 63% possession, fight until the end.
away.es: Sigan empujando pese al marcador, tienen 63% de posesión, peleen hasta el final.
away.pt: Continuem lutando apesar do placar, têm 63% de posse, batalhem até o fim.
away.fr: Continuez à pousser malgré le score, vous avez 63 % de possession, combattez jusqu au bout.

headline.en: Rangers cling on as minutes tick away
headline.es: Rangers resisten con el tiempo en su favor
headline.pt: Rangers seguram vitória nos minutos finais
headline.fr: Les Rangers tiennent bon dans le temps additionnel

story.en: Eastholme Rangers up 2-1 at 89', red card for Eastholme makes lead safer, win chance rises from 83% to 91% as the clock runs down.
story.es: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 al 89', expulsión en Eastholme endurece la defensa, la probabilidad de victoria sube de 83% a 91% con el reloj en contra del rival.
story.pt: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 aos 89', cartão vermelho para Eastholme reforça a vantagem, a chance de vitória sobe de 83% para 91% com o tempo a acabar.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers 2-1 à la 89e, carton rouge pour Eastholme sécurise l'avance, la probabilité de victoire passe de 83 % à 91 % alors que le temps s'écoule.

analyst.en: Eastholme lead 2-1 at 89 with xG 1.25 to 0.46, Brackenford have 65% possession. The biggest driver of the eight point swing was the clock running down, which reduced comeback probability.

home.en: Hold tight, favorites. Clock is on our side, see this one home.
home.es: Manteneos firmes, favoritos. El reloj nos sonríe, rematemos esto.
home.pt: Aguentem firmes, favoritos. O relógio joga a nosso favor, fechar isso.
home.fr: Tenez bon, favoris. Le temps est de notre côté, finissons ce match.

away.en: Keep believing, team. Still time to nick it, never stop fighting.
away.es: Seguid creyendo, equipo. Aún hay tiempo para empatar, no dejéis de pelear.
away.pt: Continuem acreditando, time. Ainda há tempo para buscar, não parem de lutar.
away.fr: Continuez d y croire, équipe. Il reste du temps pour égaliser, ne lâchez rien.

headline.en: Rangers Hold On as Time Runs Out
headline.es: Rangers aguantan mientras el tiempo expira
headline.pt: Rangers seguram a vantagem até o fim
headline.fr: Les Rangers tiennent jusqu'au coup de sifflet

story.en: Eastholme Rangers' win chance jumps from 91% to 100% as the clock ran down, sealing a 2-1 finish. Rangers played down to 35% possession, scored twice, and had a red card late.
story.es: La probabilidad de victoria del Eastholme Rangers sube del 91% al 100% con el tiempo cumplido, cerrando un 2-1. Los Rangers tuvieron 35% de posesión, marcaron dos veces y recibieron una tarjeta roja al final.
story.pt: A chance de vitória do Eastholme Rangers sobe de 91% para 100% com o tempo a terminar, confirmando o 2-1. Os Rangers tiveram 35% de posse, marcaram dois gols e receberam um cartão vermelho no fim.
story.fr: La chance de victoire des Eastholme Rangers passe de 91 % à 100 % lorsque le temps s'est écoulé, scellant un 2-1. Les Rangers ont eu 35 % de possession, marqué deux buts et reçu un carton rouge en fin de match.

analyst.en: Eastholme Rangers 35% possession, 1.26 xG; Brackenford City 65% possession, 0.46 xG. Biggest driver: clock running down, shifting win probability from 91% to 100%.

home.en: That was grit, not luck. Hold your heads high, we shut it down.
home.es: Eso fue coraje, no suerte. Manteneos orgullosos, lo cerramos.
home.pt: Isso foi raça, não sorte. Mantenham a cabeça erguida, seguramos o resultado.
home.fr: C etait du cran, pas de la chance. Gardez la tête haute, on a fermé le match.

away.en: You made them work. Keep your heads up, we created chances until the end.
away.es: Les hicisteis trabajar. Manteneos arriba, creamos ocasiones hasta el final.
away.pt: Fizemos eles suarem. Cabeças erguidas, criamos chances até o fim.
away.fr: Vous les avez fait travailler. Gardez la tête haute, on a créé des occasions jusqu au bout.
